fair_value_reason: Blend of (a) NTM non-GAAP EPS at Sep 2027 of ~$29.3 (2/12 FY27 $27.67 + 10/12 FY28 ~$30.0, trimmed ~1% for December reset risk) x 9.1x = ~$267 and (b) after-SBC FCF of ~$9.1B (TTM $8.47B grown ~7.5%) on ~363M shares = ~$25.1/share at a 9.4% yield = ~$267. Net debt of ~$0.7B is immaterial. This is ~$2 below the agents' round-2 mean ($269.4). I hold the multiple and yield at roughly today's level (8.8x / 9.1%) rather than the 9.5x used by agents 1 and 5, because consensus EPS has not absorbed the leadership turnover.

thesis_triggers.event: Below ~$178, about 6% under the June 2026 low of ~$190 and ~6.4x FY27 consensus EPS despite a ~9% after-SBC FCF yield and ~7%/yr share shrink, the market would be pricing a cut in earnings power rather than a lower multiple. Examples: a December FY27 guide from the new CEO implying low-single-digit organic ARR growth, Q4 net new ARR well below the guide-implied ~$0.78B, a margin reset, or further senior departures from the Creative business.

supervisor_summary: All five agents took the round-1 fixes (fiscal-year EPS weighting, after-SBC FCF, a 362-365M share count), and their fair values have converged to $262-277 (mean $269). My fair value is ~$267, at roughly today's multiple, because consensus FY27 EPS has not been cut for the turnover. The gap between that fair value and the ~$249 median forecast (spot $238) is justified: the new CEO gives his first guide ~Dec 9 with an interim CFO and no named head for the Creative business (~3/4 of revenue), and organic net new ARR fell 37% in Q3. That risk is offset by a ~9% after-SBC FCF yield and a ~7%/yr share shrink. I keep the forecasters' mean ladder (P(>=spot) ~55%) with low confidence, and suggest a small position built in two tranches, with the second after the December guide.
key_drivers: The ~Dec 9 Q4 FY26 print and FY27 guide, the first under CEO Chakravarthy (starts Dec 1), with an interim CFO and no named successor to Wadhwani, who ran ~3/4 of revenue. Consensus FY27 EPS ($27.62-27.67) has not yet been cut.
Organic net new ARR: -37% y/y in Q3. The FY 10.2% ARR guide implies Q4 ~$0.78B (~-16% y/y). Missing that figure is the main path to the thesis break.
Valuation floor: ~8.8x NTM EPS, ~9.1% after-SBC FCF yield, net debt ~$0.7B, and a ~$2.2B/quarter buyback taking the share count from 389M to ~363M.
Competitive evidence: Figma +48%; Canva ~$4B annualized revenue with in-house models cutting AI serving costs ~90%. The AI-disruption rotation dominates the multiple.
Further org change: Jefferies expects more departures, and retention letters (Jul 2026) show the board anticipated attrition.
